name: browser_exec
description: Execute a Python browser automation script against the live CDP browser session. Preloaded stdlib helpers are available without imports: cdp(method, params=None, target_id=None, timeout=30.0), ensure_real_tab(), goto_url(url, wait=True), wait_for_load(timeout=15.0), page_info(), js(expression, await_promise=True), fill_input(selector, value), click_at_xy(x, y), capture_screenshot(path=None, full_page=False), new_tab(url='about:blank'), switch_tab(target_id), list_tabs(), close_tab(target_id), list_frames(). Standard output is returned verbatim; call browser_exec with one cohesive script per step.

code.description: Python script to run against the live browser via preloaded CDP helpers.

session.description: Optional browser session name (1-64 chars matching [A-Za-z0-9_.-]). Reuse across steps to stay attached.
